## Lesson materials

- **Online grammar quiz:** [5th Grade English Quiz: Test Your Grammar Skills](https://www.proprofs.com/quiz-school/story.php?title=mjgyoda4naugdk) — a scan-friendly, 10-question multiple-choice quiz. The resource itself identifies its audience as grades 4–6, so it is a solid approximate fifth-grade warm-up. It includes verb tense, nouns, proper nouns, adverbs, plurals, adjectives, and homophones.

- **Printable marketing activity:** [The Marketing Mix — Biz Kid$ Episode 211 (PDF)](https://bizkids.com/wp-content/uploads/Biz_Kids_Lesson_211.pdf) — classroom lesson/activity packet built around **product, price, placement/place, and promotion**. Its activity materials include a Family Activity Sheet and Biz Term$ worksheet; the accompanying lesson listing identifies the marketing-mix activity for grades 6–10, making it suitable for an eighth-grade introduction. A related accessible guide is also open: [Episode 211: The Marketing Mix (DCMP PDF)](https://dcmp.org/guides/TID7070.pdf).

## Short-deck template

- **Template:** [Digital Marketing Presentation](https://slidesgo.com/theme/digital-marketing) — a free, modern white/gradient/geometric marketing template. It is a good shared deck choice: use the clean opening slides for the grammar warm-up, then the marketing icons, charts, and infographics for the 4 Ps activity.
- **Preview:** **Available** on the template’s resource page before download.
- **Formats:** **Google Slides and PowerPoint** (also editable in Canva).

“Today we will warm up with a short grammar quiz, then practice how people use basic marketing strategies like product, price, place, and promotion. Read each direction carefully and do your best.”

Keep the relevant pages open and provide one clean summary.
